graph_clone_nn

Source: R/clone_dis.R
graph_clone_nn.Rd

Compute Clone-to-Clone Nearest Neighbor Distances on a Cell Graph

Usage

graph_clone_nn(
  graph,
  cell_clone_prob,
  prob_thresh = 0.1,
  k = 2,
  clone_block_size = 25L,
  verbose = FALSE,
  distance_cache_mb = 64
)

Arguments

graph

An `igraph` object representing the cell-cell distance graph.

cell_clone_prob

A numeric matrix of clone membership probabilities (cells × clones).

prob_thresh

Threshold for binarizing clone assignment probabilities (default: 0.1).

k

Integer. Number of nearest neighbors to select for each clone comparison (default: 2).

clone_block_size

Integer. Number of target clones whose cells are included in each fallback graph-distance block when the source-clone distance cache would exceed `distance_cache_mb`. Smaller values reduce peak memory at the cost of additional graph-distance calls (default: 25).

verbose

Logical. Whether to print progress during processing (default: FALSE).

distance_cache_mb

Non-negative finite number. Maximum size in MiB of the numeric source-clone distance cache per worker (default: 64). Distances to all remaining target cells are computed once and reused when they fit; otherwise target-clone blocks are used. Set to 0 to disable this cache. This is not a total RAM limit: the graph, temporary matrices, fallback blocks, and other workers require additional memory.

Value

A data frame with columns `group1`, `group2`, and `dis` indicating the NN distance between clones.

Details

Calculates clone-level nearest neighbor distances based on a shared cell-cell graph. Uses binarized clone membership to find inter-clone distances, and applies a greedy k-nearest neighbor approximation.
